==Original Dream Journal Entry That Inspired The Episode==
I am being hunted. I used to be a member of a superhero team. When I quit to do things my way, they became obsessed with forcing me to rejoin.

My base of operations is a treehouse. It is located in a snowy mountainous region. The conditions make it difficult for my hunters to pursue me.

A speedster manages to get to my base and attacks me. I use a body change technique to take over the speedster's body. I run to the base of my pursuers to take them down with the speedster's might, but my alarm goes off and I wake up before I get the chance to get into a serious battle.
